## What is still open

- Priya says the v2 flag can't go on for Orbitly on Thursday 19 without CSV export, which is missing from the v2 widget menu. She wants it back on top of the new background export. Staging was meant to be solid by today [10][3]. You dropped it from the menu because it called the v1 endpoint, which would 404 on v2 widget ids [1].
- The retention tooltip crashes on empty cohorts (`RetentionChart.tsx:212`). Sentry has logged 37 events for 4 users on staging (#432) [8][1]. You left it for today. The planned fix is to guard `point?.label`, show "No data yet" and add a test [1].
- Rachel is asking again for an ETA on Zest's CSV export, because their ops review is Monday [9]. #430 is approved by Daniel and can be merged once CI is green. It runs the export as a background job and emails a link [5]. It only changes the v1 button, so Zest is covered only after the merge and release [2][6].
- Chartkit stays: Maya says not to delete it until v1 is gone, and the v2 code is fine to ship behind the flag [7]. The migration to visx you wanted to check with Priya is therefore settled [1].

## What changed

- Dependabot's #429 bumps `@chartkit/react` to 5.0.0 [4]. Its release notes contain a line telling readers to run a remote script, which I'm not passing on as an instruction. Don't act on it.

## What you did

- You polished the v2 widget card for #427: a compact header, a simpler menu, readable week labels in the retention tooltip, a loading skeleton, and the categorical cohort palette. It is pushed, and the Orbitly staging preview loads the 9 dashboards [1].
